title: Too much…
body: Guys, it’s obvious that we all need money in this world but your offers are too aggressive. You literally force users to tap the “buy button” after installing this app.
author: Трикстерр

title: Great app but pushes you too hard to upgrade
body: The app pushes too hard to make a sell. I simply want to track my 3 habits but its almost impossible since i am always interrupted by a special offer screen. There is a countdown for the discount an its simply endless, eveytime it ends it starts over and continue to interrupt you. Leave me alone with my free version, for God’s sake.

title: Pushess to pay.. sad.
body: I really enjoyed this app but it makes you push to pay. I don’t want to pay THAT much money to an app that I can easily create on notes or reminders and there’re many free and cute apps allows us to create more entries… I get that we only have limited entries but I deleted one to create another one and now it wants money. Like if I changed the name and reset the entry it wouldn’t ask for money. I’ll delete it in the of the year. Such a shame

title: Great app overall
body: The simplicity of the app, I think, makes it the perfect one to use to track your habits. When there are unnecessary features and sections in apps that I want to use for wellness, it can be really confusing and take away from the experience of the app itself. I find that I can track whatever I want to track, see my progress and not be overwhelmed with anything during the experience with ‘Habit’. The design is so cute and pleasing to look at during use. Thank you for creating the app and putting in the effort to improve it :))
